title: “Can’t wait to see where you go:” A father’s voicemail anchors new UNI commercial
summary_en: Those words close a father’s voicemail to his college-aged student in the University of Northern Iowa’s new 30-second commercial, which will begin airing soon on Iowa television stations and streaming platforms such as Hulu and YouTube.
title_cn: “Can’t wait to see where you go:” A father’s voicemail anchors new UNI commercial
